S.FORM: alang ruku daya ga niya mki sku Nanto Keng atu Nin'ay go, kwara sali buwan nya ga buwan, hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga kyan ku hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga kyan ku hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, . maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na ruku daya hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na ruku daya hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na ruku daya hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na ruku daya hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na ruku daya hya' ga toda. tay 'llaw na ruku daya hya' ga truwan. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ ruku *aja ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku nanto keŋ atu ninʔaj ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa βuwan ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa kjan ku ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa kjan ku ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na ruku *aja ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na ruku *aja ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na ruku *aja ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na ruku *aja ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na ruku *aja ħjaʔ ɣa to*a taj ʔllaw na ruku *aja ħjaʔ ɣa truwan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
